protocol.status: Declared before the new strict-subset fits; specification sensitivity, not final service selection
protocol.purpose: Respect Problem A each portfolio uses all three asset classes; assess the existing grid implementation without modifying any prior 232-candidate research result.
protocol.history: Development scenarios 1–120 and old V1 final results were already inspected during prior exploratory work. This is prospective specification of a new procedure on reused development data, not preregistration on unseen data or a fresh blind test.

interpretation.problem_requirement: Each portfolio uses equities, government bonds, and a cash-like short-term investment.
interpretation.old_232: The zero-weight-permitting 232-candidate family is a mathematical relaxation, not automatically a final three-asset product specification.
interpretation.strict_grid: Restrict the already fixed 5-percentage-point grid to all three weights at least .05 and retain exact one-third. Expected count 172. This is a finite-grid realization of strictly positive holdings, not the whole continuous open simplex.
interpretation.five_percent: The .05 floor is the smallest strictly positive point on the pre-existing grid. Positivity alone does not uniquely imply a 5% minimum; this is not an identified risk or liquidity preference or a claim of continuous optimality.

candidate_family.selection_rule: all(weights >= .05 - 1e-12), retaining original ascending candidate order, including exactthird
candidate_family.index_space: All solver candidate_index/indices in strict artifacts remain LOCAL 0..171; explicit original232 fields and mapping are saved for every candidate reference. Market cache always uses original232 columns; nested fits and path_records always use consistently sliced arrays.

protocol.nested_procedure: Call unchanged run_nested_static_calibration.calibrate_context on the subset weights and subset metrics for all six exact original contexts. No new calibration logic.

eligibility.profile_test: For each profile with at least one automatic inner OOF path, conditional breach_count/auto_n <= service_alpha + 1e-12. Profiles with auto_n=0 retain null risk/growth and do not pass as zero-risk observations.
eligibility.whole_zero_coverage: A gamma with zero automatic paths across all profiles is ineligible, reason=no_inner_auto_outcomes.
eligibility.meaning: An empirical pointwise heuristic on dependent inner folds and possibly small, selected automatic subgroups. It is not statistical risk certification or guaranteed calibration.

priority: Maximize automatic inner OOF path-profile count
Within exact maximum coverage, maximize mean annualized log growth over automatic path-profile units
Within a single 1e-12 band below that maximum growth, choose the smallest gamma
selection.representation: The five supplied profiles have equal original path counts. They are representatives, not population frequencies. The conditional auto-unit growth objective weights profiles according to the automatically served path counts; service composition can change across gamma.
selection.no_eligible: selected_gamma=null and calibration_unsupported; do not force gamma=0 or call a negative/default screen. Preserve all effective assignments as Review and financial outcomes as null.

refit_and_admission.raw_fit: After gamma selection, refit the unchanged fit_menu once using all current context training scenarios at the chosen gamma. Do not choose weights/products based on outer test paths.
refit_and_admission.raw_menu_objective: The original coverage/minimax-regret/mean-regret objective describes the raw fit before admission guard. It is not a globally optimized objective after the guard.
refit_and_admission.guard: Retain the raw menu, raw assignment and raw evidence. If a raw assignment is automatic but that profile had auto_n=0 in the selected gamma inner OOF, effective assignment=Review with reason=no_inner_auto_evidence. Do not refit targets, fill replacement products or silently remove raw evidence.
refit_and_admission.partial_coverage: For inner auto_n>0 retain the stated eligibility rule. Report auto_n and automatic fold count; add no arbitrary minimum n, four-of-four condition or additional tuned threshold.

unchanged_parameters.inner_score_vs_effective_service: Inner gamma scoring evaluates the raw menu/assignment process. Outer and full effective outputs additionally apply the declared admission guard. The inner objective does not directly globally optimize the post-guard effective service; report raw and effective coverage separately.

protocol.fixed_gamma_reference: Independently fit the strict subset at fixed gamma=.10 on full120 and each original96 outer train, evaluating all24 outer paths without inner calibration; gamma is the training technical screen and service alpha remains .10.
protocol.old_relaxation_references: Saved 232 primary gamma=.10 and saved 232 nested full/OOF are reported separately. Do not combine fitted products, assignment or candidate spaces across families.
protocol.postfit_upper_bound: The unchanged calibrate_context retains family_events=1160 from the original232x5 superset, rather than claiming the tighter860-family calculation. This conservative diagnostic does not enter fitting, gamma selection or admission; no dynamic or pooled-OOF certificate.
required_checks: Exact172 count, all three weights>=.05, exactthird retained, original order retained
All metric fields sliced along candidate axis1 and equality to their recorded original232 columns
Every menu and index-list reference has explicit local-to-original mapping; fitted weights exactly match mapped global weights
Outer evaluation values/NaNs cannot affect calibrate_context fitting; original six contexts and inner IDs unchanged
All assigned path outcomes equal direct original cache lookup at mapped global candidate; referrals remain NULL
Source/input start/end SHA plus guarded cache data SHA; no final121-180 reading
reporting: All strict inner gamma summaries, folds and path outcomes
Strict nested full/OOF raw and effective assignments with selected gamma
Strict fixedgamma.10 full/fivefold fits and path metrics
Strict-vs-relaxed summaries and paired common-auto changes with denominators
No final winner is selected or epsilon added to prior zero holdings
prohibited: Modifying package, old protocols/results, report or notebook
Interpreting positivity as automatic risk suitability, or changing service alpha
Claiming global continuous optimization or unseen validation

candidate_index_space: LOCAL strict172 throughout candidate_index/indices; added original232 fields and candidate_mapping give global cache addresses
scope: Finite-grid strict-positive specification sensitivity on reused development data. Old232 family is a relaxation. No final winner or service is adopted; 5% is grid resolution, not identified client risk/liquidity preference or continuous optimality.
inference: Service alpha=.10 differs from technical gamma. Inner eligibility is a dependent-fold heuristic. Postfit1160 bounds conservatively retain the old232x5 superset; no pooled OOF certificate or guarantee for dynamic policies.
